reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Moving Zimbabwe Towards Malaria Elimination: Strengthening Evidence-Based Programming - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Malaria, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria incidence to 15/1000, malaria deaths by at least 90% by 2026 and accelerate towards malaria elimination.. The objectives of this program are: To protect 100% of the population at risk of malaria with an appropriate malaria prevention intervention for the period 2021-2026.. To provide prompt and quality assured diagnosis for all malaria suspected cases and treatment to all confirmed cases for the period 2021-2026.. To achieve zero local malaria transmission in at least 11 districts and increase the elimination districts to 36 by 2026.. To increase utilization of malaria interventions to at least 85% of the targeted population by 2026.. To strengthen surveillance, monitoring and evaluation and operational research for all malaria interventions for the period 2021-2026.. To foster an enabling environment for optimal program implementation and impact for the period 2021-2026.
